reward.scheduler: completion-refill-v1: preselect a uniform original candidate; advance when it finishes, normalize only after all 8; no length-based filtering.
reward.reward: Legal Q-max(Q); invalid/truncated min(Q)-max(Q), over ALL legal actions, native utility scale.
reward.baseline: Within the SAME actual node: (reward-mean)/(sample_std+1e-8); range <= oracle epsilon has zero task advantage.
reward.weighting: Node groups equal; candidates equal; response tokens averaged. No inverse chain-length weight.
reward.failure: Separate protocol advantage=-0.2 on failed calls only; selected failure terminates without retry.
reward.batching: Target actual node groups, including zero-signal groups; stop admissions at target and finish admitted chains; one update, one pass.
reward.reset: One entrance/world/focal per chain; all candidates at a node share prompt, posterior and remaining k.
reward.continuation: Uniform original candidate, duplicates retained, score-independent; saved terminal reference advances partners and focal after k.
reward.objective: On-policy sampled-context oracle action-value surrogate; not a terminal-return policy-gradient estimator.
reward.infrastructure: Transport, context, missing behavior evidence and oracle failures abort collection without committing cursor.
